description: Free-text search of the White Automotive & Media Services GM electronics catalog. Returns name, SKU, price, availability, categories and URL per match; with no exact match, returns the closest and says so. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: inputs under "catalog". Example: {"query":"HMI module"}

catalog.description: UCP form. Needs query, filters.categories or both.

price.description: min and max in minor units (cents).

pagination.description: Pass the previous response cursor for the next page.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.

query.description: Simple form, required. Product type, model or platform, e.g. "digital cluster Silverado". Synonyms work ("screen", "gauges").

name: search_catalog
title: Search catalog
